user_scope: One from-zero binary diverse_04 full 20% compression plus hold, overriding previous long-path deferral; no arbitrary low-compression or high-KE stop.
occupancy_rule: phi=1 where reference midsurface distance_normalized <= t_mm/(2 L_mm)=0.025; otherwise 0; includes boundary
mass_model: Recompute existing positive HRZ from eta+(1-eta)*phi, including the same numerical void density floor; no mass scaling.
start: undeformed stress-free zero-velocity; no saved-state restart
PBC: XYZ periodic fluctuation, macro lateral strain zero
controller: Existing sole explicit entry state_step_target, diagnostic in-memory adapter only. State tangent bound safety 0.8; endpoint dt sqrt(R)<=2; finite rollback; only decrease dt.
minimum_dt_reason: Before launch, allow eight additional halving levels over old artificial initial/16 safeguard; numerical floor and finite total cost remain. Not selected by curve agreement.
budget_reason: Preserve earlier user preference for a single attempt <=3 hours; no 15 minute body cutoff.
metrics: Common-covered original compression grid; RMS normalized by both frozen old reference peak and matched rate/case loading peak; signed loading work; original observed peak; hold time mean if complete. No strain shift, fitted scale or smoothing.
working_goal_scope: Research comparison target; not continuum accuracy certification. Full diagnostics may be completed without meeting reference/energy gates.
limitations: Binary27 integration sensitivity established by r40; no dense nonlinear path certificate.
Changing occupancy changes stiffness, HRZ mass and required-positive-J point set; do not attribute path change solely to initial stiffness.
No self/image contact; high KE allowed but nonfinite force/tangent or nonpositive actual J at solid Gauss points rejected.
No design AD; hard binary threshold not proposed as final differentiable geometry representation.
Endpoint material/bound checks do not certify all intermediate time positions.
